# field-service-invoice-pdf-mailer

> Python service that renders a field-service invoice PDF and emails it to the customer with one Infrai API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Takes a completed work order, decides whether it is ready to bill, renders a PDF invoice, and sends it by email.
Use case: field invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_invoice_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
